column1: # The cases of tests/review_loop_reader_eval.sh: changes with known defects.
# The fields of a line are separated by one tab.
# The source of a case is the commit of a squash-merged pull request of this
# repository, or a path from this file: a repository with the branches main
# and review, or a folder with the two trees main/ and review/. The floor is
# what the review command of the host named in three runs. A run names a
# defect when one finding line of its report matches both patterns, with
# grep -iE. "was" is the count of the last recorded pass of three runs.
